US officials meet Zelensky amid Ukraine-Russia war talks

US officials Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met with Ukrainian President Zelensky as part of negotiations concerning the Ukraine-Russia war. The meeting occurred as US-Ukraine relations are described as being at new lows.
